subject: agent-runtime-assembly
seam: tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/topology.ts resolveSessionTopology (session-declared > session-name > env > unknown) + EDITOR_ONLY_TOOLS
tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/index.ts advertisedTools(raw, session) / toolVisibility(name, raw, session) — the roster and the refusal derive from one resolution
tools/pof-mcp/src/index.ts sessionTopology() = resolveSessionTopology(server.getClientVersion()), called per request, never memoised; server.oninitialized logs topology + source
seam_notes: pof-mcp already had opt-in group gating keyed on POF_MCP_TOOL_GROUPS but nothing session-scoped: every session got all 50 tools regardless of who connected. Topology now resolves from the MCP initialize handshake's clientInfo (explicit clientInfo.topology first, then a name table), with the env path (POF_MCP_TOPOLOGY, then the HARNESS_MODE/CI shape e2e/helpers/ci-harness.ts uses) kept only as a fallback when the session declares nothing, and 'unknown' when neither speaks — unknown advertises the FULL surface, so an absent marker is never rendered as 'no editor'. Measured with the env vars blank: editor 50 tools, headless 46, web 46, nothing-declared 50 (was 50 for all four). The four withheld are the pof-bridge tools that need a live editor; pof_ue_status stays because it is the reachability probe and reports connected:false honestly. The editor-only list is guarded by a test asserting each named tool's own description says it needs a live editor — that guard failed on first run and exposed a real gap: pof_ue_test_results reads through pof-bridge but never said so; its description was corrected rather than the guard weakened. | gate: green — typecheck clean; 75/75 unit tests pass including the two new stdio tests that spawn the real server with HARNESS_MODE/CI/POF_MCP_TOPOLOGY explicitly blank; the 36 contract/quality itests skipped cleanly (PoF backend not running at 127.0.0.1:3001), so the contract lane is unproven rather than failing
falsifier: Set clientInfo.topology to 'editor' with POF_MCP_TOPOLOGY, HARNESS_MODE and CI all unset: if pof_ue_compile is absent from tools/list, the env read is back. Conversely a declared headless session that still lists it means the topology filter was dropped from advertisedTools. The direction is void if every client that reaches pof-mcp is spawned by PoF itself and always carries the marker — untrue today, since the Claude Code CLI connects over stdio from an .mcp.json entry that sets neither.

subject: test-harness
seam: src/__tests__/**/__snapshots__ (vitest snapshots for the prompt golden rail, evaluator traces, knowledge registries); package.json test = vitest run; no CI workflow and no guard against a committed -u
seam_notes: Technique: snapshot expectations are re-approved only behind an explicit switch that CI asserts off, so a re-approval is a visible decision and never a side effect of a source change. Experiment over git history (all commits touching a *.snap or __snapshots__ path): 17 commits, 17 of which also changed non-test source under src/ in the same commit, 0 snapshot-only commits. The exposure the technique names is total here, but nothing in the tree can measure whether any of those 17 re-approvals hid a regression - there is no gate that sees a snapshot change, so the technique's effect has no instrument yet.
measurable: snapshot re-approvals that carry no explicit approval signal: 17 of 17 today
instrument_needed: a check (pre-commit via lefthook, or a CI job when one exists) that fails when a __snapshots__ file changes in the same change as src/ without an explicit approval marker (an env switch or a commit trailer); count the marker-less re-approvals over the next 20 snapshot commits
return_condition: when pof gains a CI workflow or a pre-commit hook that sees test files; then run the check and re-grade as experiment better/not-better
